Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1351

Kevin Clayton

February 16, 2023
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind at a stop. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
March 2, 2023
Reviewed the police report and the photographs taken at the scene. The other driver's statement matches the
claimant's account of how the collision occurred.
May 10, 2023
Wtiness statements were obtained and both independently describe the impact as it is recorded in the file. Their
accounts are consistent with the scene photos.
June 1, 2023
Vehicle damage to the rear bumper, trunk lid and tail lamp assembly is consistent with the reported force of the
impact. No prior damage to these areas appears in our records or in the inspection notes.
June 20, 2023
Claimant reoprts neck and back strain. The described injury is a typical result of a collision of this type and force, and
no prior injury to the same body area is known to us.
July 2, 2023
Poilce and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver is listed on the
policy, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
August 30, 2023
Claimant's account of events has stayed the same in every recorded conversation, including the initial call, the
recorded statement and later correspondence thruogh counsel.
September 12, 2023
Medical treatment bgean with an initial evaluation and physical therapy. Over the following months, visit frequency
increased and additional services were added, which is more than is usually needed for this injury. Requested
records from the treating providers.
September 15, 2023
Reviewed the treatment billing against typical care for a strain of this kind. The extended course and added services
are noted for discussion with the medical reviewer before any settlement position is set.
September 24, 2023
Referred the treatment question to the medical review unit and sent the attorney a request for updated records and a
current treatment plan. Next review scheduled once the response is received.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
